critical_code_review_comments: routes/referral.py: _verify_hmac returns 'REFERRAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET not configured' early — in dev where the secret is unset, EVERY non-super_admin webhook call will be rejected. That is the intended behavior for now per the iter-129 note, but main agent should set REFERRAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET in backend/.env before any real payment-gateway webhook integration goes live, otherwise webhooks will all 403.

routes/contacts.py _normalize_professional_roles: silently drops any role row without an 'organization' value. If the frontend sends a partially-filled new row (e.g., only designation) it will vanish without an error — consider returning a 400 or surfacing a warning so UX doesn't appear to 'lose' the user's input.

routes/six_legs.py convert_to_action: only writes created_at/updated_at as datetimes; serialization to ISO strings happens through FastAPI's default jsonable encoder. Works correctly today, but using _now_iso() (string) directly would be more defensive and consistent with action_items.py.
